name: Fire Elemental
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Fire Form
traits.description: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. A creature that touches the elemental or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage. If it deals fire damage to a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, the object ignites.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: The elemental sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

traits.name: Water Susceptibility
traits.description: For every 5 feet the elemental moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 Cold damage.

actions.name: Touch
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it ignites.

description: Fire elementals are living blazes summoned from the Elemental Plane of Fire, wreathing anything they touch in flame and leaving only scorched earth in their wake.
